records.consumer: repositoryFiles -> checkYaml/checkSkills per-state validation (those validators are not executed by this dependency-free fixture).
records.contract: Index and working records for the same path are separate inspection inputs. A valid working file cannot replace an invalid staged blob.

environment.consumer: repository-files.mjs:git -> gitEnvironment; also backup.mjs:run and agent-evaluation.mjs:git.
environment.contract: Caller-supplied Git environment variables must not redirect or configure inspection subprocesses; ordinary non-Git variables survive. Test only a synthetic core.bare injection, never global configuration.

backup.consumer: createGitBackup -> backupDestination; target resolution includes all linked worktrees before any backup write.
backup.contract: A NEW backup path under another linked worktree is forbidden even when outside the current checkout. An external sibling with an existing parent is allowed. No backup creation is permitted in this review.

metadata.contract: Unavailable endpoint exports stay UNVERIFIED; failed read text must not be copied into exported files. Missing branches cannot trigger branch protection exports. All endpoint failures are injected, with a precreated empty output directory.
